source.original_question: Determine the equation of the graph.

adaptations.reason: Original ellipse semiaxes 9 and 3 exceed the fixed x range; uniformly scaled by 2/3 to semiaxes 6 and 2, retaining its 3:1 shape and graph-to-equation task.

independent_solution.method: Read centre [0, 0], horizontal semiaxis 6 and vertical semiaxis 2; substitute into (x-h)²/a²+(y-k)²/b²=1.

audit.routing: Official Plane Geometry / Analytic source classification retained; coordinate diagram rendered under Analytics fixed-window protocol.
